title: React Native Developer
description:
React Native Developer – Fresher

**Location:** Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Experience:** 0–1 Year  
**Pass\-Out Year:** 2025 / 2026  
**Preference:** Tiruppur Local Candidates

Job Description

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **React Native Developer – Fresher** to join our development team. This is an excellent opportunity for 2025/2026 graduates who have a strong interest in **React Native and mobile application development**.

The ideal candidate should have basic knowledge of React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, and mobile app development, along with good logical and problem\-solving skills.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **React Native**
* Knowledge of **JavaScript / TypeScript**
* Basic understanding of **React.js / ReactJS**
* HTML and CSS
* REST APIs and JSON
* Git / GitHub
* Basic understanding of mobile application development
* Good logical and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication skills
* Willingness to learn and work on real\-world projects

Education

* BE / B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc / MCA or equivalent qualification
* **Only 2025 and 2026 pass\-out candidates are eligible**
* Freshers with React Native projects, internships, academic projects, or relevant coursework are encouraged to apply

Candidate Preference

* **Tiruppur local candidates preferred**
* Candidates who are willing to work **From Office in Tiruppur**
* Immediate joiners are preferred

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume:

**Email:** aishwarya.bm.findq@gmail.com  
**Call / WhatsApp:** 8681945935

**Note:** Only **2025/2026 pass\-out candidates** will be considered for this position.

Work Location: In person

title: React Native Developer(Mobile app Developer)
description:
**We are hiring**  Mobile App Developer ( **React Native Developer) !!**

**Job description :**  
We are seeking a skilled **React Native Developer Intern** to join our mobile development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building high\-quality, performant mobile applications for **iOS and Android** using **React Native**. You'll collaborate with designers, backend developers, and product managers to deliver intuitive and scalable mobile solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and build advanced applications for iOS and Android using **React Native**.
* Design, develop, and maintain mobile applications using React for iOS and Android platforms.
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create seamless and visually appealing user experiences
* .Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, third\-party services, and native modules as required.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance and responsiveness.
* Manage app releases and deployment to the **App Store** and **Google Play**.
* Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following best practices.
* Debug and resolve technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and crashes.
* Stay updated with emerging trends and technologies in mobile development.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Experience : 1 year**
* Strong proficiency in **JavaScript**
* Solid understanding of **mobile UI/UX principles** and responsive design.
* Experience with **native modules**, **Redux**, or **Context API** for state management.
* Familiarity with **RESTful APIs**, **Git**, and **mobile debugging tools**.
* Experience publishing apps to **App Store** and **Google Play Store**.

**How to Apply :**  
**Send your resume to: talent@skyappzsoftware.in and 9600222284**

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Junior Golang Developer with React
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**

**NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform\-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


As a Software Engineer I at NCR VOYIX, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of innovative software solutions, working within an agile team to deliver high\-quality products that enhance customer experiences and business operations.  

  

Job Responsibilities  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software applications and systems using various programming languages and technologies.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, QA engineers, and other developers, to define requirements, design solutions, and ensure successful product delivery.
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and performance issues in a timely manner.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of software development processes, tools, and methodologies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, API documentation, and user guides.
* Stay up\-to\-date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying new knowledge to projects where appropriate.

  

Job Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 1\-2 years of professional experience in software development.
* Strong proficiency in at least one of the programming language (e.g., Go, Java, Python, C\#, JavaScript). Go is preferred.


Strong proficiency in TypeScript.React (Mandatory)

* Strong proficiency in MySQL or PostgreSQL, including database design and SQL query optimization (Mandatory).
* Experience with one of the cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and microservices architecture.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design principles.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.


Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

**EEO Statement**
